subject: Contract Impasse with Medford Teachers Association
overview: The Committee reviewed school opening operations and staffing shortages while addressing a formal impasse in contract negotiations with the Medford Teachers Association. Members also approved resolutions regarding secure firearm storage education and federal Title IX amendments.

items.title: Good of the Order: Committee Goals
items.summary: Approved a motion to schedule a Committee of the Whole meeting within several weeks to set annual goals for the body.

items.title: Consent Agenda and Superintendent Report
items.summary: Approved meeting minutes and recognized new administrators and community partners following the opening of the school year.

items.title: Transportation Operations Update
items.summary: Discussed traffic remediation at the high school and the potential consolidation of bus stops located within one or two miles of schools, pending safety analyses by the police department.

items.title: Personnel and Paraprofessional Shortages
items.summary: Reported 15 to 17 paraprofessional vacancies and discussed the impact of low wages on recruitment and the legal requirement to provide special education services.

items.title: Labor Update: Teachers Contract Impasse
items.summary: Detailed the district's decision to seek state mediation for contract negotiations with the Medford Teachers Association, highlighting a disagreement over using temporary grant funds for base salary increases. Union leadership and teachers criticized the impasse declaration, arguing that current pay is non-competitive with surrounding districts.

items.title: Resolution 2022-43: Secure Firearm Storage
items.summary: Approved a resolution directing the superintendent to update student handbooks and communicate with parents regarding legal obligations for secure firearm storage under Massachusetts law.

items.title: Report on Enrollment and Summer Programs
items.summary: Noted a significant rise in freshman enrollment and reviewed participation in special education, English Learner, and credit recovery summer programming.

items.title: MASC Delegate and Policy Updates
items.summary: Appointed Paul Ruseau as delegate to the MASC annual conference, approved the first reading of rescinded policies, and tabled voting on MASC resolutions until the next meeting.

items.title: Resolution 2022-42: Support for Title IX Amendments
items.summary: Approved a resolution calling on the state's congressional delegation to support proposed federal Title IX amendments intended to strengthen protections for LGBTQI+ students.
